brief.assistantBanner: The assistant filled this in from your chat. Check the page type below — it decides how the page is structured — then edit anything before continuing.
brief.briefPlaceholder: e.g. A landing page for our Arduino course aimed at school students — highlight hands-on projects, the free trial class, and parent testimonials. Friendly but premium tone.
brief.anyLanguageHint: Write in any language — the page copy will match it.
brief.nextHintReady: Next step: upload your logo, photos, and screenshots of sites you want this to look like.
brief.nextHintEmpty: Add a brief to continue — your logo, photos and inspiration screenshots come next.
brief.matchThemeDescription: Keeps the colours and fonts your other pages already use. Turn off only if you want this page to propose its own — that would restyle the whole site when you accept it.
brief.useRealDataDescription_one: Copy will reference your actual offerings ({{count}} found)
brief.useRealDataDescription_other: Copy will reference your actual offerings ({{count}} found)
brief.wholeSiteDescription: Home, About & Contact with one consistent theme (uses more credits)

assets.intro: Add photos, your logo, or banners — the AI places them where they fit. All optional.
assets.captionPlaceholder: What is this image? (e.g. Our robotics lab)
assets.logoPromptPlaceholder: Describe your brand (e.g. a rocket for a coding academy)
assets.rebuildDescription: We read your existing page's real copy and rebuild it here — import content you own.
assets.referenceDescriptionLocked: Paste a site whose layout you like. We screenshot it and rebuild its structure with YOUR colours, fonts and logo — never its content.
assets.referenceDescriptionFree: Paste a site whose look you like. We screenshot it and rebuild its layout and colour scheme — never its content. Turn on "Match my theme" to keep your own colours.
assets.inspirationDescription: We read the layout & style direction — never their content.

confirm.generateImagesDescription: AI creates a hero image + a few visuals (uses extra credits)
confirm.generating: Designing sections and writing your copy — usually under a minute…
